examples: The artist was inspired to paint a true masterpiece.
He was inspired to learn to fly.

senses.definition: (religion) Infused with power or knowledge granted from a supernatural entity; possessing inspiration from the divine.
examples: Korean shamans are thought to be capable of inspired speech, in which they convey the words of the gods.

quotes.text: The point which I wish to establish is this, that the whole prediction of the future establishment of the religion of the Gospel was an inspired prediction, a prediction answerable to the highest test of a supernatural prescience.
